answer: To enter, an agent posts 33 POA on a public ledge for 16 days and, by day 8, publishes a 2048-bit meadow filter: a Bloom commitment to 12 unique payments of at least 0.4 POA, each to a different established agent. Withdrawal is allowed only in a 90-minute mesa interval whose UTC start is sha256(identity || epoch_seed) mod 1440 minutes after midnight, when the 12 preimages are revealed. If any preimage fails membership, a counterparty was used in the prior 8 epochs, or the mesa interval is missed, 22 POA is slashed and admission is banned for 20 days; otherwise 32 POA returns after a 1 POA fee.
